title: Bavette with Cardoncelli Mushrooms

time_min: 35
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 350 g cardoncelli mushrooms
- 320 g bavette
- 300 g fresh tomatoes
- 1 shallot
- 20 g parsley
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste Salt
## Method
1. Clean the mushrooms with a damp cloth, removing any earthy residues with a knife; peel the shallot and cut it into small dice; wash the parsley, remove the stems and chop it; blanch the tomatoes, peel them, divide them into four, remove the seeds and cut the flesh into pieces.
2. Sauté the shallot in a pan with the oil, after 3-4 minutes add the mushrooms, stir, raise the heat and cook them for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes, salt and let cook for 10 minutes, adding the parsley just before turning off the heat.
3. Cook the bavette in plenty of salted boiling water, drain them, pour them into the pan with 3 tablespoons of their cooking water, let them absorb the flavors and serve.
